title: Ibex mesh seat & back drafting stool
body_html:
A drafting stool that breathes — built for the bench, the lab, and the standing-height desk where the day is spent on your feet and off them.

The Global Ibex is a drafting-height task stool with a breathable air-flow mesh back and an upholstered, contoured seat, designed by Zooey Chu. Its pneumatic seat lifts from 23" to 33" to meet counter- and drafting-height work surfaces, a height-adjustable chromed footrest supports your legs at elevation, and height-adjustable T-arms round out the fit. Built in Canada, GREENGUARD and ANSI/BIFMA certified, and backed by Global's Limited Lifetime Warranty.

Key features

  • Drafting-height stool: pneumatic seat height 23"–33"
  • Breathable air-flow mesh back
  • Upholstered, contoured seat — fabric or Luxhide bonded leather
  • Height-adjustable chromed footrest
  • Height-adjustable T-arms
  • Waterfall seat front edge
  • Back-height adjustment
  • Dual-wheel casters (carpet or hard-floor)
  • Designed by Zooey Chu
  • GREENGUARD, ANSI/BIFMA and ISO 14001 certified

Who it's for

Standing-height and drafting workstations — design studios, labs, reception and service counters, workshops, and inspection benches — where staff move between sitting and standing through the day.

Brant Business Interiors carries the Global Ibex drafting stool and delivers across Ontario, with installation available. Call 1-800-835-9565 to choose seat upholstery, casters, and OECM pricing.
